build_bruteforce_searcher: build a brute force searcher that finds nearest neighbors via dot product similarity on document embeddings
create_searcher_index: create a Searcher instance and build an embedding index from document vectors for retrieval
search_batched_queries: search batched query embeddings against a built index and return top-k ranked document indices and similarity scores
constrained_bruteforce_search: run a constrained brute force search that restricts retrieval to a specific list of document indices
normalize_cosine_similarity: normalize document and query embeddings to compute cosine similarity instead of raw dot product
